segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on from the control room; Case Blackwell joins at 07:11 for the live countdown.

segments.title: War with Iran: Unilateral Declaration & Escalation
segments.notes: Case Blackwell anchors a solo monologue on the overnight U.S.–Iran war declaration, covering Trump's Mar-a-Lago address, F-15 losses, the Hormuz closure, AI target selection via Claude, and 555 reported Iranian deaths including 165 from a school strike; Kendelle walks through at 36:25 with theme music; Hype Train interrupts at 58:38.

segments.title: Technical Interruption & Viewer Thanks
segments.notes: Stream stalls for three minutes during Kendelle's upload; Case thanks subscribers and bits, announces Crum's court date Friday.

segments.title: Hype Train Derailment: Bugs Bunny & Bart Simpson Lore
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the feed with a freestyle rap asserting Bugs Bunny and Bart Simpson are in a mafia-powered sexual union that threatens reality; Case and Rick react with bafflement.

segments.title: Trump Bruise Watch: Neck Lesion & Cream Guild
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate whether new neck bruising indicates Trump rotting from the inside; Munch invokes his Schmaglin & Crint cream guild membership and vampire DNA origin story; Crum practices legal testimony for Friday's peen.dot.UI lawsuit.

segments.title: Pubic Shaving Tutorial & Accent Barrier
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget presents a Gillette India four-step shaving guide featuring John's thorough demonstration; follows with an accent-reduction app drill that devolves into Spanish-language legal-ad spam.

segments.title: Couples Therapy with Dr. Chath
segments.notes: Dr. Chath conducts a telepathic session interrupted by aggressive dancing, Spanish loan ads, and a Cody Rhodes musical hallucination; Case graduates after admitting fear of therapy and JD Vance resemblance anxiety.

segments.title: IP Lawyer vs. 30 Bart Simpsons
segments.notes: Attorney Bartholomew Mould (Mould, Grout & Scrant) attempts copyright enforcement against a parade of rapping Bart Simpson avatars; each claimant is voted out and apparently killed by the tribunal; Mould exits in legal peril.

segments.title: Raid Outro & G4 Curse
segments.notes: Case raids Will Neff while spreading the 'curse of G4 memories'; Pepito reveals he was Bart Simpson for six years after eating one.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored solo war monologue, moderated Munch & Crum, endured therapy, and failed to depose 30 Bart Simpsons as IP counsel.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold open, managed stream recovery, announced Crum's Friday court date, and confessed to a six-year Bart Simpson possession.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walked through with theme music at 36:25, declined Q&A, revealed sushi-cat shirt from Hawaii, and advocated 'put an end to it all' on global conflict.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debated Trump's neck lesions, claimed surprise lawyer for Friday's peen.dot.UI lawsuit, and practiced perjury-adjacent testimony.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued Trump is fine via cream-guild logic, revealed vampire DNA from vampire girlfriends, and proposed returning to the wall.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical interruption. Derailed war coverage with a freestyle asserting Bugs Bunny and Bart Simpson's mafia-backed sexual union threatens humanity.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: correspondent. Read chat donations during war segment, praised falling F-15 pirouettes, and questioned Hype Train's furry yaoi output.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: instructional host. Hosted How To with Jeb featuring a graphic pubic-shaving tutorial and a malfunctioning accent-barrier app.

characters.name: Dr. Chath
characters.notes: therapist. Conducted telepathic couples therapy, danced aggressively, played Spanish loan ads, and graduated Case after a Cody Rhodes vision.

characters.name: Bartholomew Mould
characters.notes: legal counsel. Appeared as IP attorney in Jo Rogen Experience, attempted to enforce Simpsons copyright against 30 rapping Barts, and fled under threat of murder liability.

storylines.beat: [01:28:37] Munch asks 'More wall content?' and suggests 'We could go back to the wall,' referencing the resolved hell-transit arc.

Expressed desire to lose weight to stop resembling JD Vance.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with a solo anchor monologue on the unilateral U.S. declaration of war against Iran, covering F-15 losses, the Hormuz closure, and Anthropic's Claude selecting targets. The broadcast devolved through a Hype Train freestyle on Bugs Bunny–Bart Simpson mafia lore, a Munch & Crum debate on Trump's neck lesions and Munch's vampire origin, a graphic Jeb Nogget shaving tutorial, a telepathic therapy session with Dr. Chath, and a Jo Rogen Experience where an IP attorney was overwhelmed by 30 rapping Bart Simpson claimants. The show closed with a raid on Will Neff and Pepito's confession of a six-year Bart Simpson possession.
